title: DynaStash ER-Walnut
description:
Dynastash ER – Walnut
The walnut DynaStash ER is your premium storage solution for any 92mm vapcap. The DynaStash is made out of beautiful natural walnut wood and is only 11cm tall and 5cm wide. And is capable of carrying one 92mm vapcap, a finger size amount of your favourite herb, concentrates and also comes with a stoking tool with magnetic end. The DynaStash ER is perfect for out and about users but also provides a safe home for your vapcap in any situation.
The DynaStash ER also comes standard with the dynamag magnet. This magnet provides a handy spot to put your vapcap while cooling. And can also be used to remove the cap itself without having to touch it with your hands.
Please note that xl sized vapcaps will not fit inside this dynastash.
Included
1 x Walnut DynaStash ER
1 x Pointed Tool
1 x Silicone Concentrate Container
